name: Sorin Markov
description: Sorin Markov is an ancient vampire planeswalker, lord and protector of Innistrad, who created the angel Avacyn and helped imprison the Eldrazi on Zendikar.

summary.text: Sorin Markov is an ancient vampire planeswalker, lord and protector of Innistrad, who created the angel Avacyn and helped imprison the Eldrazi on Zendikar.

bio.text: With Ugin and Nahiri he helps focus the power that completes the hedron network and imprisons the Eldrazi on Zendikar.
He travels to Tarkir to find Ugin and, in the altered timeline, wakes him and tells him the Eldrazi are free.
On Innistrad he asks Olivia Voldaren for help against a threat, and then destroys Avacyn by performing his creation ritual in reverse.
He hurls his former protege Nahiri into the Helvault, and after her release she calls Emrakul to Innistrad and traps him in a stone cocoon, where Olivia leaves him.
Years later he refuses to give Arlinn the Moonsilver Key, then tries to stop Olivia's wedding to his grandfather Edgar.
Edgar defeats him and throws him into a pit, but Sorin heals with the pit's blood, duels Edgar in the ballroom and spares his life.
A 2026 account says he betrayed Edgar by imprisoning him in the Helvault.

status.text: Sorin is alive, and his last major event shows him sparing his grandfather Edgar after defeating him in the ballroom, while a later mention places him shoring up Innistrad's defenses with Arlinn.

timeline.summary: The journal says Sorin created Avacyn to hold the vampires in check and that the church keeps humans as livestock, never able to defeat them; Dovid concludes his faith is a lie.
timeline.quote: We are livestock. We are unwitting participants in our own cultivation.

timeline.summary: Sorin arrives on Tarkir in search of the spirit dragon Ugin, led by an oracle's visions toward a dragon-head mountain peak.
timeline.quote: Somewhere up there was his destination.

timeline.summary: Sorin dominates a warrior sentry and drains him dry to feed.
timeline.quote: drained him to a pale husk.

timeline.summary: Sorin worries over Nahiri's silence and Ugin's absence while the Eldrazi titans rampage on Zendikar.
timeline.quote: The Eldrazi titans were a fire that could not be quenched, and Ugin's absence was strange.

timeline.summary: A Temur band mistakes Sorin for a Sultai demon-spawn and Sorin kills two warriors with death magic and raises them as vampire thralls.
timeline.quote: Sorin reached out his hand and willed the two leathery corpses back from the dead.

timeline.summary: Sorin turns Rushka against his captain, who beheads him, and a vampire thrall drains the captain.
timeline.quote: the captain reacted like a cat and struck the shaman's head off with one blow from his jawbone axe.

timeline.summary: Sorin dominates a surviving warrior to serve as his guide to Ugin.
timeline.quote: You shall serve me,

timeline.summary: The Temur guide tells Sorin that dragons have been hunted to extinction and that the Spirit Dragon gave the Temur magic to fight corrupted dragons.
timeline.quote: But some say that the dragons became greedy and corrupt, so the Spirit Dragon gave us magic to fight them.

timeline.summary: The guide leads Sorin to a chasm where only huge bones lie, and Sorin refuses to believe it is Ugin.
timeline.quote: That cannot be Ugin.

timeline.summary: Sorin descends into the chasm, finds Ugin's skull in the ice and discovers Ugin is dead.
timeline.quote: Ugin was dead. And with him fell the hopes of countless worlds.

timeline.summary: Sorin fears Zendikar and then Innistrad will be consumed and says they are all doomed.
timeline.quote: We're all doomed,

timeline.summary: Sorin urges Nahiri to leave the refugees and focus on stopping the creatures before they spread to other worlds; Nahiri insists they are there to save the people.
timeline.quote: I'm here to stop these creatures, on this world, before they spread to others—to mine, or to yours.

timeline.summary: Sorin admits that they are not winning against the creatures.
timeline.quote: No," he said.

timeline.summary: Nahiri, Sorin and Lian fight the first wave of Eldrazi brood at the wall, but the titan's pull drains their magic.
timeline.quote: Nahiri could feel her mana spiraling away even as she gathered it.

timeline.summary: The plane begins to come apart as a crack in the world opens and the refugees are swept away.
timeline.quote: The plane was coming apart.

timeline.summary: Sorin flashes away and Lian is taken by the light; Nahiri grabs the sword and planeswalks off the dying world.
timeline.quote: Silently cursing herself, Nahiri grabbed the sword and left the world behind.

timeline.summary: Nahiri and Sorin regroup at a kor settlement in Akoum on Zendikar.
timeline.quote: Nahiri clutched the sword, the last trace of a now-dead world.

timeline.summary: Ugin appears as a luminous dragon, and Nahiri meets him for the first time.
timeline.quote: Then he was there with them: a massive, ethereal dragon, shining with blue-white light.

timeline.summary: Ugin reveals he watched the destruction without helping, in order to learn about the Eldrazi, and explains what they are and why they cannot simply be killed.
timeline.quote: They're called the Eldrazi," said Ugin, "and they devour entire worlds.

timeline.summary: Ugin proposes imprisoning the three true Eldrazi on a single plane, binding them with physical anchors and forcing them into dormancy.
timeline.quote: Bind them to one plane using their physical forms as anchors, and force them into dormancy.

timeline.summary: Ugin describes the ideal prison world, and Nahiri realizes he means Zendikar, refusing at first.
timeline.quote: What gives me the right to put everyone here in danger?

timeline.summary: The three titans Ulamog, Kozilek, and Emrakul arrive on Zendikar, and Ugin and Sorin fight their brood as the titans march toward the hedron nexus.
timeline.quote: Ugin breathed his ghostfire, searing the Eldrazi brood with invisible flame.

timeline.summary: Nahiri, Sorin and Ugin focus their power in the Eye of Ugin and shift every hedron into its final position, completing the network.
timeline.quote: Every single hedron on the plane glowed as they shifted into new positions.

timeline.summary: The three Eldrazi stand petrified over Akoum and the chamber is sealed with a lock that requires three Planeswalkers to open.
timeline.quote: Looming above the highlands of Akoum, the three Eldrazi stood petrified, surrounded by a web of floating hedrons.

timeline.summary: Nahiri vows that her work is just beginning as she looks up at the imprisoned titans.
timeline.quote: My work is just beginning.

timeline.summary: Sorin arrives on Tarkir, uneasy beneath the sun, searching for Ugin who may be dead and guided only by an oracle's vague visions.
timeline.quote: His only guide now was a cluster of vague impressions given to him by an oracle.

timeline.summary: A party of Atarka warriors mistakes Sorin for a Silumgar death-spawn and threatens to take his head.
timeline.quote: Your head will decorate a spear tonight.

timeline.summary: Sorin enthralls a warrior as a guide and learns from him that the khans fell, the dragons now rule, and Ugin dwells in the Haven.
timeline.quote: Ugin is the beating heart of the world. He dwells within the Haven.

timeline.summary: Sorin sees the hedron cocoon in a chasm and wonders if Nahiri was there.
timeline.quote: Lithomancy on Tarkir? Had Nahiri traveled here before him and bested the dragon?

timeline.summary: Sorin drains the thrall of what blood remains and uses blood magic to destroy the hedron shard and unmake the cocoon, freeing Ugin.
timeline.quote: The hedron shard crumbled to dust, and the cocoon began to crack.

timeline.summary: Ugin explodes from the ruins, recognizes Sorin, and says he was saved after Bolas attacked him using his own dragons.
timeline.quote: He thought me his rival for power, and attacked me. Used my own dragons against me.

timeline.summary: Sorin tells Ugin that over a thousand years have passed and the Eldrazi have escaped their hedron prison on Zendikar, partly through Nissa's choice.
timeline.quote: They're free." Sorin had the urge to press the matter, to needle Ugin, to make someone else shoulder the blame.

timeline.summary: Ugin asks about Nahiri, and Sorin evasively says she lives but is not on Zendikar; Ugin insists all three of them must work together.
timeline.quote: Let me be clear. It must be the three of us.

timeline.summary: Ugin agrees to join Sorin at the Eye of Ugin, and Sorin planeswalks away from Tarkir.
timeline.quote: I will join you at the Eye soon.

timeline.summary: Ugin recounts that Sorin Markov woke him and spoke of foolishness at the Eye.
timeline.quote: An ally of mine, a vampire and a Planeswalker, woke me up and spoke to me of 'foolishness at the Eye.'

timeline.summary: Sorin fights through Temur hunters, makes a vampire guide and finds Ugin dead in the canyon, concluding the Multiverse is doomed.
timeline.quote: Ugin is long since dead, and Sorin concludes that the Multiverse is doomed.

timeline.summary: Six thousand years earlier, Nahiri and Sorin fail to save an unknown plane from the Eldrazi, then agree with Ugin to imprison the titans on Zendikar.
timeline.quote: The trap is sprung, the titans are subdued, and Nahiri settles in for a long vigil to keep them imprisoned.

timeline.summary: Sorin, with no memory of an earlier visit, destroys the cocoon and awakens Ugin, who tells him the Eldrazi are free.
timeline.quote: Sorin destroys the cocoon and awakens Ugin.

timeline.summary: Ugin insists it must be the three of them, and Sorin agrees to find Nahiri and meet Ugin on Zendikar.
timeline.quote: Reluctantly, Sorin agrees to seek out Nahiri and meet Ugin on Zendikar to stop the Eldrazi.

timeline.summary: Nahiri frees herself from her cocoon, goes to the great hedron, and sends a summons to Sorin and the Spirit Dragon.
timeline.quote: she sent her call into the Æther

timeline.summary: After waiting, Nahiri realizes Sorin and the Spirit Dragon have not come and she is alone.
timeline.quote: They hadn't come. Sorin hadn't come. She was alone.

timeline.summary: Nahiri, angry that Sorin abandoned her, decides to find him and wake him, and opens a pathway through the Blind Eternities to another plane.
timeline.quote: eager to find her oldest friend.

timeline.summary: Jace commits to helping, and Ugin asks him to find Sorin Markov, whom he warns not to trust, or else Nahiri.
timeline.quote: If you want to help, then seek him out, bring him here, but . . . do not trust him.

timeline.summary: Ugin, Nahiri and Sorin imprison the Eldrazi titans on Zendikar using a network of hedrons built by Nahiri.
timeline.quote: The Planeswalkers' trap worked.

timeline.summary: A little over a thousand years ago the Eldrazi nearly escape and Nahiri restores their prison alone, then goes to check on her absent allies and is not seen again.
timeline.quote: Nahiri restored the Eldrazi's prison on her own

timeline.summary: Sorin returns with Nissa to seal the Eye, but Nissa breaks the last bonds and the Eldrazi titans emerge.
timeline.quote: she broke the last bonds holding them in, and the titans emerged into the world.

timeline.summary: Ugin scolds the planeswalkers for killing two ancient beings, says he will study their remains, tells Jace to leave, and warns of Sorin and Bolas.
timeline.quote: have proven to be an extremely arrogant and unreliable partner.

timeline.summary: Ugin departs, and Jace and Gideon decide that Jace will go to Innistrad to find Sorin Markov.
timeline.quote: I'll go to Innistrad and find Sorin.

timeline.summary: Jace reveals he is looking for Sorin Markov, surprising Liliana.
timeline.quote: I'm looking for Sorin Markov,

timeline.summary: Jace explains that Sorin helped trap the Eldrazi on Zendikar and that Jace and two other planeswalkers inadvertently freed them (recounted).
timeline.quote: Manipulated and coerced, two other Planeswalkers and I inadvertently released the Eldrazi titans from their prison.

timeline.summary: Liliana recalls her one meeting with Sorin long ago, when he tested and dismissed her and warned her to be a civil guest (recounted).
timeline.quote: He sought me out, tested my strength in battle, and pronounced me too weak to be a threat.

timeline.summary: Liliana warns Jace not to seek Sorin, saying he is ancient, ruthless and powerful.
timeline.quote: And I am telling you, don't go.

timeline.summary: Jace reads in the journal that Sorin made Avacyn to protect humans so that vampires would not overfeed.
timeline.quote: Sorin made her.

timeline.summary: Jace concludes that the angels have gone mad and turned on the humans, and someone tore apart the manor.
timeline.quote: The angels have turned on the human populace.

timeline.summary: Jace resolves that the journal will help him find Sorin through the angels.
timeline.quote: This will help me find Sorin.

timeline.summary: Sorin walks through Olivia Voldaren's masked ballroom to confront her.
timeline.quote: A hundred or more pairs of eyes watched him from behind elegant masks as he made his way across the ballroom.

timeline.summary: Olivia mocks Sorin and orders him thrown out, saying the scion of Edgar Markov is not welcome.
timeline.quote: The scion of Edgar Markov is not welcome here

timeline.summary: Sorin cuts down five of Olivia's vampires and blasts the last, a duelist, to ash with a clenched fist.
timeline.quote: his assailant's body burst apart in a scattering of ashes

timeline.summary: Sorin tells Olivia he has come for her help.
timeline.quote: I have come for your help.

timeline.summary: Sorin tells Olivia that his grandfather's manor is in ruins; Olivia blames Avacyn and says she destroyed Castle Falkenrath.
timeline.quote: She's already destroyed Castle Falkenrath and scattered that bloodline.

timeline.summary: Flashback: Sorin, still weakened from creating Avacyn, is pulled from his restoration by the arrival of another planeswalker.
timeline.quote: Something had pulled him prematurely from his restoration.

timeline.summary: Flashback: Sorin finds the lithomancer Nahiri beside the Helvault.
timeline.quote: Sorin knew her immediately.

timeline.summary: Flashback: Nahiri says the Eldrazi broke free of their bonds and she resealed their prison alone.
timeline.quote: With all the strength I could muster, I managed to reseal the titans' prison.

timeline.summary: Flashback: Sorin explains the Helvault is half of what he created to protect Innistrad, perhaps blocking her signal.
timeline.quote: This Helvault is half of what I created to serve as such protection.

timeline.summary: Flashback: Nahiri accuses Sorin of abandoning her and breaking their agreement; Sorin dismisses her, recalling that he took her under his wing.
timeline.quote: When your Planeswalker spark first ignited, it was I who discovered you.

timeline.summary: Sorin tells Olivia he created Avacyn to protect the world, and that a dangerous person has come to threaten it.
timeline.quote: I created her to be this world's protector.

timeline.summary: Flashback: Nahiri raises a field of floating stones, forges a sword from stone and demands Sorin return with her to Zendikar.
timeline.quote: You will return with me to Zendikar.

timeline.summary: Flashback: Sorin blocks Nahiri's sword, disarms her and holds a blade to her throat, ending the fight.
timeline.quote: Sorin brought the point of his blade up to her throat.

timeline.summary: Sorin asks Olivia to summon her bloodline to join the Markov remnants against the threat.
timeline.quote: Summon the might of your bloodline, Olivia.

timeline.summary: Olivia agrees to help Sorin, on the condition that he first helps her.
timeline.quote: I will help you. But first you will help me.

timeline.summary: Sorin crashes through the skylight into the cathedral and blocks Avacyn.
timeline.quote: I look up to see the skylight explode, a man crashing through it feet first.

timeline.summary: Sorin tells Avacyn something is wrong with her and that he has come to help.
timeline.quote: There's something wrong with you, Avacyn

timeline.summary: Avacyn hurls holy magic at Sorin twice, but he is unharmed.
timeline.quote: I hurl the holy magic at him, and it hits him full in the chest.

timeline.summary: Sorin reveals he is Avacyn's creator, which is why she cannot harm him.
timeline.quote: I am your creator

timeline.summary: Avacyn recognizes Sorin as the reason she exists, who gave her mission to protect.
timeline.quote: He is the reason I exist.

timeline.summary: Avacyn condemns Sorin as the greatest evil of the world for creating her flawed.
timeline.quote: Sorin Markov, I condemn you as the greatest evil of this world.

timeline.summary: Avacyn lunges at Sorin with her spear but misses him.
timeline.quote: I lunge with the spear, using every bit of my divine strength.

timeline.summary: Avacyn summons the angels from the rafters to attack Sorin.
timeline.quote: He looks up to see the angels I have called down on him.

timeline.summary: Sorin destroys Avacyn's angels one by one, draining one.
timeline.quote: One by one he destroys my angels.

timeline.summary: Avacyn, seeing Sorin as a monster, can finally harm him and slashes his neck.
timeline.quote: I slash my spear through his neck, cutting deep enough to hit bone.

timeline.summary: Avacyn drives her spear through Sorin's chest plate and into the wall.
timeline.quote: I sink my spear through the gap in the monster's chest plate, so deep that the blade hits the granite of the cathedral wall on the other side.

timeline.summary: Sorin reveals his full strength, pins Avacyn and bites her neck.
timeline.quote: He bites my neck, and the pain is like a thousand innocents screaming

timeline.summary: Sorin drives Avacyn through the cathedral floor into the cellar where she was made.
timeline.quote: When we slam to a halt, we lie in the cellar of Thraben Cathedral

timeline.summary: Sorin offers to cleanse her mind and remake her; Avacyn refuses to be anyone's instrument.
timeline.quote: I am no monster's instrument. I will not be altered by the likes of you.

timeline.summary: Sorin destroys Avacyn by performing a ritual in reverse, revoking his gift, and she dies with a final prayer.
timeline.quote: words of a ritual performed in reverse, words of a gift being revoked.

timeline.summary: Jace demands to know what Sorin has done as Avacyn is gone, leaving the cathedral vacant.
timeline.quote: Avacyn was no more. The cathedral felt overly large now, somehow.

timeline.summary: Sorin sheathes his sword and leaves up the stairs as Jace asks what he has done.
timeline.quote: Jace watched Sorin shove his sword into his scabbard and turn away

timeline.summary: Sorin appears behind Nahiri and she greets him joyfully.
timeline.quote: My friend!" she managed to say at last. "You're alive!

timeline.summary: Nahiri tells Sorin she resealed the Eldrazi prison alone after neither he nor Ugin answered her signal.
timeline.quote: With all the strength I could muster, I managed to reseal the titans' prison.

timeline.summary: Sorin reveals the Helvault may have blocked Nahiri's signal and shows no concern.
timeline.quote: This Helvault is half of what I created to serve as such a protection.

timeline.summary: Flashback: Early in their acquaintance, Sorin broke Nahiri's arm in a lesson and told her she was no longer mortal.
timeline.quote: You broke my arm!

timeline.summary: Nahiri accuses Sorin of abandoning her and breaking their agreement.
timeline.quote: You risked my plane, and more.

timeline.summary: Recounted: Nahiri stood watch over the imprisoned Eldrazi for five thousand years, then fought them off alone when they escaped.
timeline.quote: For five thousand years, Nahiri stood watch over their monstrous prisoners.

timeline.summary: Sorin tells Nahiri he owes her nothing and that he molded her, telling her to bother Ugin instead.
timeline.quote: I took you under my wing, and molded you into what you are

timeline.summary: Nahiri calls up a granite column and swirling stone darts, declaring she is not going anywhere.
timeline.quote: She called forth a column of rock from the depths beneath them

timeline.summary: Nahiri's stone column swallows Sorin and he breaks free in a burst of light.
timeline.quote: but the stone column simply swallowed him.

timeline.summary: Sorin binds Nahiri with a beam of moonlight, and she realizes the moon is made of silver like the Helvault.
timeline.quote: It was made of silver. Like the Helvault.

timeline.summary: Nahiri forges a sword from stone and demands Sorin return with her to Zendikar.
timeline.quote: You will return with me to Zendikar.

timeline.summary: Sorin stops Nahiri's sword with his own and explains the angel is the other half.
timeline.quote: The other half,

timeline.summary: Sorin disarms Nahiri, puts his sword to her throat, then hurls her into the Helvault, which absorbs her.
timeline.quote: Then the Helvault claimed her, and she vanished into a darkness vast and total.

timeline.summary: The angel enters the Helvault to fight the demons and Nahiri realizes Sorin made her.
timeline.quote: He had made her. Just like the Helvault.

timeline.summary: Nahiri swears that as Zendikar has bled, so will Innistrad, and as she has wept, so will Sorin.
timeline.quote: As Zendikar has bled, so will Innistrad.

timeline.summary: Olivia and Sorin accuse Liliana of freeing the Lithomancer.
timeline.quote: You released the Lithomancer and brought this upon us.

timeline.summary: Sorin threatens Liliana, and she answers that death is hers.
timeline.quote: Innistrad may be your domain, Sorin,

timeline.summary: Olivia calls Sorin outside, saying Nahiri awaits.
timeline.quote: Join me outside. Nahiri awaits.

timeline.summary: Sorin says the world is ruined and that Jace will die at Thraben.
timeline.quote: This world is ruined,

timeline.summary: Sorin and Olivia lead the Voldaren vampire army off to battle Nahiri, not to help the people.
timeline.quote: The vampire army marched off down the hill, swords and pikes and red-hot priest symbols held high

timeline.summary: Sorin's vampire army arrives with banners and knights opposite the manor.
timeline.quote: The first of Sorin's forces to arrive were the banners, ancient cloths that hung from black wooden poles

timeline.summary: Nahiri steps out sword in hand to welcome Sorin.
timeline.quote: Sword in hand, Nahiri stepped out into the dull light of the day

timeline.summary: Nahiri raises stone walls to create a passage between her and Sorin and impales vampires and cultists on stone quills.
timeline.quote: on either side of her, two parallel walls rose up a dozen feet from the floor.

timeline.summary: Sorin launches death magic at Nahiri, but it veers away and strikes him, because magic flows through leylines and stone.
timeline.quote: They suddenly broke apart, and flew in several directions, tracing contours in the air that were otherwise invisible.

timeline.summary: Nahiri tells Sorin she brought Emrakul to his doorstep.
timeline.quote: I brought Emrakul to your doorstep, and you still think I'm a child.

timeline.summary: Nahiri declares she is done being a warden and that Zendikar will never again be a prison, so Emrakul had to go somewhere.
timeline.quote: I'm done being a warden, and Zendikar will never again be a prison.

timeline.summary: Olivia arrives overhead with vampire knights and says she cannot allow Nahiri her revenge.
timeline.quote: But he's also earned my help, so I can't allow you your revenge.

timeline.summary: Olivia and her vampires wade into the monsters while Sorin pursues Nahiri through the floating ruins.
timeline.quote: By the time Nahiri was among the unmoored, broken remnants of the manor's vaulted ceiling, Sorin was on her heels.

timeline.summary: Nahiri upends a landing under Sorin, but he swings and escapes.
timeline.quote: Nahiri grabbed hold of the landing with her will and upended it.

timeline.summary: Sorin's blade breaches the stone and stabs Nahiri in the side.
timeline.quote: Then there was a loud crack, and agony shot through her side like a hot poker.

timeline.summary: Sorin stands over wounded Nahiri, saying she should have killed him when she had the chance.
timeline.quote: You had the chance to kill me, young one.

timeline.summary: Sorin bites Nahiri's neck and drinks her blood.
timeline.quote: Before a muscle could even twitch, she felt Sorin's teeth tear into her neck.

timeline.summary: Nahiri drives stone tusks into Sorin and traps him in a stone cocoon.
timeline.quote: The stone crashed in around them, and rows of jagged stone tusks tore into Sorin from his legs to his ribs.

timeline.summary: Nahiri whispers that she spared him, a courtesy returned.
timeline.quote: I spared you," Nahiri said. "A courtesy returned.

timeline.summary: Nahiri planeswalks away from Innistrad, leaving Sorin trapped.
timeline.quote: Nahiri planeswalked away from Innistrad, leaving Sorin to the fate of his world.

timeline.summary: Sorin, trapped, watches Emrakul drift across Gavony toward Thraben.
timeline.quote: The horizon was Emrakul.

timeline.summary: Olivia taunts Sorin, declares the bargain fulfilled, and leaves him trapped.
timeline.quote: Avacyn is dead. Nahiri has been driven off. Our bargain is fulfilled.

timeline.summary: Olivia pushes Sorin's sword against his cheek and floats away, leaving him in stone.
timeline.quote: you're where you are. I think it's quite good.

timeline.summary: Nahiri sees Sorin and attacks, but it is a Jace illusion, and Jace seizes control of her mind.
timeline.quote: Suddenly, her thoughts were not her own.

timeline.summary: Arlinn tells Dennick his father is dead and asks about the key; he says his great-grandfather gave it to a vampire of the Markovs for safekeeping.
timeline.quote: My great-grandfather gave it over to one of the vampires for safekeeping.

timeline.summary: Dennick names Sorin Markov as the prince who took the key, and Arlinn stays behind to listen to him.
timeline.quote: "It's the Markovs.

timeline.summary: Arlinn forces open the throne room doors and finds Sorin Markov reading on his broken throne.
timeline.quote: Sorin Markov sits with one leg slung over the broken throne of his house.

timeline.summary: Sorin refuses to give up the key, saying he has sacrificed enough and his family may descend into eternal night.
timeline.quote: Sorin snaps the book shut. "No."

timeline.summary: Arlinn brings up Avacyn and Sorin slashes her arm with his sword, forbidding her to speak of her.
timeline.quote: She's not through the name before the sword's swinging through the air.

timeline.summary: Sigarda arrives in golden light and blocks Sorin's blow with her heron-headed scythe.
timeline.quote: A feather falls between them, gold and glowing

timeline.summary: Sigarda tells Arlinn the key is in Sorin's chambers on the third floor and fights Sorin so the others can go.
timeline.quote: You will find the Moonsilver Key in Sorin's personal chambers on the third floor.

timeline.summary: Arlinn argues that the endless night will starve the vampires too and proposes visiting Sorin Markov.
timeline.quote: "The endless night doesn't just affect humans."

timeline.summary: In a flashback to six millennia earlier, Sorin tells his grandfather Edgar that vampires will drink Innistrad dry and Edgar dismisses it.
timeline.quote: "Sorin. Do you truly believe I've never had the same thought?"

timeline.summary: Sorin recalls that after six millennia he gave humans a protector, saving Innistrad, and reflects that defeat found him.
timeline.quote: Humans needed a protector. He gave them one.

timeline.summary: Sorin goes into the family archives to wake his grandfather Edgar and ask for a plan.
timeline.quote: His grandfather had been slumbering for long enough.

timeline.summary: Sorin discovers that Edgar's mausoleum and coffin have been stolen.
timeline.quote: the coffin itself is missing

timeline.summary: Sorin crushes a bat carrying an envelope addressed to him and recognizes the handwriting.
timeline.quote: He crushes it without a second thought.

timeline.summary: Sorin finds Arlinn and the others trespassing in his library.
timeline.quote: All in his library, in his family archives

timeline.summary: Sorin reveals the invitation to Olivia Voldaren's wedding and that she has stolen Edgar; if they marry she will rule all of Innistrad.
timeline.quote: "She's stolen my grandfather.

timeline.summary: The Gatewatch and allies reach the gates of the Voldaren Estate, but the guards admit only one person per invitation.
timeline.quote: "One person per invitation," the guards intone together.

timeline.summary: Chandra remembers the Harvesttide Massacre and agrees they cannot fight without the key; Sorin agrees to enter alone.
timeline.quote: "I've been alone for centuries," he says. "This will be no different."

timeline.summary: Sorin walks through the estate escorted by guards and reflects that Olivia chose a political marriage with his grandfather.
timeline.quote: It was only natural that someone so nakedly ambitious would hit on the idea of a political marriage.

timeline.summary: Sorin is announced in the ballroom and sees his grandfather's coffin on the dais.
timeline.quote: There's no mistaking it: that is his grandfather's coffin.

timeline.summary: Olivia cuts her arm to let her blood drip into Edgar's coffin to wake him.
timeline.quote: Old blood, potent blood, blood dark as the night around them, drips onto Edgar Markov's coffin.

timeline.summary: Sorin charges at Olivia, killing one guard and freezing two, but is bound with Blessed Silver chains by the guards.
timeline.quote: When Sorin pounces on one, he tears out their throat before the two of them even hit the ground.

timeline.summary: Edgar Markov wakes, drinks Olivia's blood and is presented as her betrothed; he dismisses Sorin's warnings.
timeline.quote: "I present to you my handsome, perfect betrothed: Lord Edgar Markov."

timeline.summary: Olivia wakes other Markov ancients for the groom's side, and Sorin's family passes him by without a word.
timeline.quote: A few drops is all it takes to start the process of waking the ancients.

timeline.summary: Sorin, chained, studies Olivia's stained-glass window and reflects that her life has marched toward this moment of seized power.
timeline.quote: The larger picture of Olivia's life has always marched toward this.

timeline.summary: A cage draped in red descends from the ceiling, and Sorin recalls being forced by his grandfather to drink angel blood.
timeline.quote: a familiar scent comes to him—angel blood.

timeline.summary: The curtains fall to reveal Sigarda bound with red ribbons as a living gift.
timeline.quote: There is no cage save Sigarda's own wings

timeline.summary: Sorin works out that Olivia plans to control angels by drinking Sigarda's blood bound with the Moonsilver Key and Sungold lock.
timeline.quote: Olivia Voldaren with control over all the angels in Innistrad.

timeline.summary: Sorin uses blood magic to cut his chains and objects to the wedding.
timeline.quote: A blade of red-black slices through the chains as easily as any sword.

timeline.summary: Sorin fights through the guards and seizes a gold-encrusted sword to kill Olivia.
timeline.quote: Three more fall in quick succession, crushed beneath the weight of the new weapon.

timeline.summary: A flash of light throws off Sorin's cut, and Olivia drops the Moonsilver Key.
timeline.quote: Grasping for the now-falling key, Olivia is furious.

timeline.summary: Sorin shoves his grandfather aside and fights Olivia to buy the spirit time, and a verdant bolt frees Sigarda.
timeline.quote: he dashes between her and the key, meeting her head-on charge with a wild slash.

timeline.summary: Sigarda rises freed, declares all of them guilty and shatters the hall with holy light.
timeline.quote: "All of you are guilty," speaks the angel.

timeline.summary: Sorin follows his grandfather into the sanguitorium and urges him to see Olivia is only using him.
timeline.quote: "Grandfather, you know this is foolish. She's only using you."

timeline.summary: Edgar breaks Sorin's wrist and throws him into a vat, accusing him of never being part of the family.
timeline.quote: Edgar catches Sorin's wrist, his fingers a vise.

timeline.summary: Sorin batters Edgar with an iron pipe, but Edgar insists he created Avacyn from his research and has squandered his gift.
timeline.quote: "Your little toy soldier? Yes, I'm aware."

timeline.summary: Edgar slams Sorin into a vat and he relives being forced to drink angel's blood at the family gathering.
timeline.quote: Memory subsumes reality.

timeline.summary: Edgar throws Sorin into a great pit.
timeline.quote: And Sorin Markov continues to fall.

timeline.summary: Sorin, lying in a pit of blood, reflects on Nahiri and Avacyn and his grandfather's betrayal, then drinks the blood to heal.
timeline.quote: They thought this cellar would drown him, but it's only made him stronger.

timeline.summary: Sorin climbs out of the pit and heads for the ballroom, no longer caring about the family there.
timeline.quote: he no longer cares

timeline.summary: Sorin cuts through the guards and duels his grandfather Edgar, defeating him.
timeline.quote: In the end, it is Edgar who falls from the rumble first

timeline.summary: Sorin spares Edgar's life and tells him to get out of his sight; Edgar flees.
timeline.quote: Sorin scowls. "Go. Get out of my sight."

timeline.summary: Edgar's grandson Sorin betrays him by imprisoning him in the Helvault.
timeline.quote: Edgar's own grandson Sorin, while in his human form, betrayed Edgar by creating and imprisoning him in the Helvault

timeline.summary: Sorin Markov intervenes and unmakes Avacyn, his beloved creation, and the plane's last protections fall.
timeline.quote: Sorin Markov finally intervened, unmaking his beloved creation.

timeline.summary: Sorin lords over Innistrad for millennia, preserving the balance between humanity and the monsters that prey on them.
timeline.quote: he lorded over his home plane of Innistrad for millennia, preserving the balance between humanity and the monsters who prey upon them.

timeline.summary: The ancient planeswalkers use the hedrons to lure, contain and immobilize the Eldrazi, who remain trapped for millennia.
timeline.quote: Unable to defeat the titans, the ancient Planeswalkers used the hedrons to lure, contain, and immobilize them.

relations.note: According to the journal, Sorin created Avacyn to rally the remaining angels.
relations.quote: Sorin created Avacyn, a force to rally our remaining angels

relations.quote: one of the three Planeswalkers who imprisoned the Eldrazi on Zendikar thousands of years ago

relations.quote: As I have wept, so will Sorin.

relations.note: She keeps her vow of vengeance.

relations.note: He warns that meddlers in his affairs die.
relations.quote: You meddle in my affairs, you die.

relations.note: She fights beside him as part of a bargain.

relations.note: She fights him for a thousand-year grudge.
relations.quote: Sorin is mine.

relations.note: Narration calls his words a mentor addressing a protege.
relations.quote: It was a mentor addressing a protégé, a final lesson to impart.

relations.note: He created Avacyn in Thraben to protect Innistrad.
relations.quote: Thraben was where he had created Avacyn to protect it.

relations.note: She aided him in a bargain, then left him trapped.
relations.quote: Our bargain is fulfilled.

relations.note: Sorin is her old mentor and sworn enemy.

pages_say.description: A planeswalker who arrived on Zendikar and joined Nissa on a journey to reach the Eye of Ugin.
An ancient and powerful member of the Markov family who created Avacyn, per the journal.
A vampire planeswalker who comes to Tarkir seeking his old ally Ugin to stop the Eldrazi, and finds the dragon dead.
A vampire planeswalker and protector of Innistrad, over a thousand years old, who fights the Eldrazi alongside Nahiri.
A vampire planeswalker from Innistrad who travels to Tarkir to wake Ugin and enlist his help against the freed Eldrazi.
A vampire planeswalker and ally of Ugin who woke him from slumber and told him of 'foolishness at the Eye'.
A vampire Planeswalker of Innistrad who seeks Ugin's help against the Eldrazi, and in the new timeline awakens him.
A Planeswalker who helped imprison the Eldrazi with Nahiri; he does not answer her summons, and she resolves to find him.
A planeswalker, self-proclaimed lord of Innistrad and an erstwhile ally of Ugin, who helped imprison the Eldrazi; Ugin warns he is selfish.
An ancient planeswalker who helped imprison the Eldrazi and later returned to Zendikar with Nissa to seal the Eye.
A tall, white-haired planeswalker whom Nissa distrusted.
An ally of Ugin whom Jace decides to seek out on Innistrad.
An ancient vampire planeswalker, the so-called Lord of Innistrad, who helped trap the Eldrazi on Zendikar and is now missing.
A vampire planeswalker, one of the three who imprisoned the Eldrazi on Zendikar, who according to the journal made the angel Avacyn; his whereabouts are unknown.
An ancient vampire planeswalker, creator of Avacyn and the Helvault, who seeks Olivia Voldaren's aid against a threat to Innistrad.
A vampire planeswalker Jace had sought.
An ancient vampire planeswalker and Avacyn's creator, who bursts into Thraben Cathedral to take her to the cellar and ultimately destroys her.
An ancient vampire planeswalker who created the Helvault and an angel, and who imprisons Nahiri when she demands he honor their agreement.
The vampire planeswalker Nahiri vows to punish; Jace curses him for leaving a mess.
A vampire planeswalker who blames Liliana for freeing the Lithomancer and leads the vampires to battle Nahiri.
An ancient vampire planeswalker who leads a vampire army against Nahiri, is stabbed and trapped in a stone cocoon, and is left by Olivia.
A planeswalker who, with Ugin, urged Nahiri to trap the Eldrazi on Zendikar.
A planeswalker who was at Nahiri's side when the Eldrazi were trapped, and whom she fought.
A vampire planeswalker and Nahiri's old mentor and sworn enemy, whose appearance in the fortress is a Jace illusion.
A vampire prince and planeswalker who holds the Moonsilver Key at Markov manor and refuses to hand it over.
A vampire planeswalker and the protector of Innistrad who learns that his grandfather Edgar's coffin is missing and that Olivia plans a wedding.
A vampire planeswalker who enters the wedding alone, tries to stop the ritual and is restrained by guards.
A vampire planeswalker who tries to stop Olivia's wedding and kill her, remembering how his grandfather forced him to drink angel blood.
A vampire planeswalker who follows his grandfather into the sanguitorium and loses their brutal fight.
A vampire planeswalker who heals himself with the blood of a pit, defeats Edgar in the ballroom and spares his life.
A planeswalker shoring up Innistrad's defenses with Arlinn.
A planeswalker who helped Nahiri and Ugin millennia ago.
A planeswalker who helped bind the Eldrazi on Zendikar.
Someone Chandra thinks might have given a smoldering stare, though he does not seem the type to race.
Edgar's grandson, who created the angel Avacyn and imprisoned Edgar in the Helvault.
A planeswalker who created Avacyn to safeguard humanity and later unmade her.
An ancient planeswalker contemporary of Nahiri.
A powerful vampire and one of the oldest surviving planeswalkers, born over 7,000 years ago, who lorded over Innistrad.
An ancient planeswalker who helped make the hedrons.
